ApiForm.type: ApiTextForm | ApiComboBoxForm | ApiCheckBoxForm | ApiPictureForm | ApiDateForm | ApiComplexForm | ApiSignatureForm

BlipFillType.description:
The type of a fill which uses an image as a background.
**"tile"** - if the image is smaller than the shape which is filled, the image will be tiled all over the created shape surface.
**"stretch"** - if the image is smaller than the shape which is filled, the image will be stretched to fit the created shape surface.

Size.description: The border width measured in eighths of a point.

Space.description: The spacing offset from the text to the border measured in points.

BulletType.description: A bullet type which will be added to the paragraph in spreadsheet or presentation.
examples:
// The paragraph will be starting with the Arabic numeral which has parenthesis
let bullet = Api.CreateNumbering("ArabicParenR");

CaptionLabel.description: Possible values for the caption label.

CaptionNumberingFormat.description:
Possible values for the caption numbering format.
**"ALPHABETIC"** - upper letter.
**"alphabetic"** - lower letter.
**"Roman"** - upper Roman.
**"roman"** - lower Roman.
**"Arabic"** - arabic.

CaptionSep.description:
Possible values for the caption separator.
**"hyphen"** - the "-" punctuation mark.
**"period"** - the "." punctuation mark.
**"colon"** - the ":" punctuation mark.
**"longDash"** - the "—" punctuation mark.
**"dash"** - the "-" punctuation mark.

ChartType.description: This type specifies the available chart types which can be used to create a new chart.

ChartTypeLegacy.description: This type specifies the legacy chart type names which are kept for backward compatibility.

ChoiceOption.description: Option for radio groups, dropdowns and combo boxes.

CommentReport.description: A dictionary of users and their comments.

IsAnswer.description: Specifies whether the comment is a response.

checked.description: Indicates whether the checkbox is checked by default.

checkedSymbol.description: A custom symbol to display when the checkbox is checked (e.g., "☒").

uncheckedSymbol.description: A custom symbol to display when the checkbox is unchecked (e.g., "☐").

ContentControlDatePr.description: The date picker content control properties.

lang.description: The date language. Possible value for this parameter is a language identifier as defined byRFC 4646/BCP 47. Example: "en-CA".

ContentControlListItem.description: The object representing the items in the combo box or drop-down list.

display.description: The text to be displayed in the combo box or drop-down list.

value.description: The value associated with the item.

CustomXmlNodeAttribute.description: Represents an attribute of an XML node.

DocumentElement.description: Any valid element which can be added to the document structure.

Drawing.type: ApiShape | ApiImage | ApiGroup | ApiOleObject | ApiTable | ApiChart | ApiSmartArt

DrawingLockType.description: This type specifies the type of drawing lock.

EMU.description: English measure unit. 1 mm = 36000 EMUs, 1 inch = 914400 EMUs.

EntryEffect.description: The available slide transition effects (similar to PowerPoint VBA ppEffect).

format.description: The date format string (e.g. **MM/DD/YYYY**). Present only for date picker fields.

key.description: The form key. If the current form is a radio button, then this field contains the group key.

label.description: The checkbox label. Present only for checkbox fields.

lang.description: The date language/locale name (e.g. **en-US**). Present only for date picker fields.

options.description: The list of available options for the field.Present for checkboxes, radio button groups, dropdown lists, and combo boxes.

roleColor.description: The form role color in hex format.

FormType.description:
Form type.
The available form types.

GeometryCoordinate.description:
The coordinate value for the geometry paths.
Can be a guide name from "gdLst", a numeric value, or a string representation of a number.

GeometryFormulaType.description: This type specifies the formula type that will be used for a geometry guide.

HdrFtrType.description:
Header and footer types which can be applied to the document sections.
**"default"** - a header or footer which can be applied to any default page.
**"title"** - a header or footer which is applied to the title page.
**"even"** - a header or footer which can be applied to even pages to distinguish them from the odd ones (which will be considered default).

ParagraphContent.description: The types of elements that can be added to the paragraph structure.

ParagraphLikeContainer.description: A paragraph-like container that can directly hold inline-level content (Hyperlink, InlineLvlSdt, etc.).

PatternType.description: The available preset patterns which can be used for the fill.

RelFromH.description: The possible values for the base which the relative horizontal positioning of an object will be calculated from.

RelFromV.description: The possible values for the base which the relative vertical positioning of an object will be calculated from.

ReviewReport.description: A dictionary of users and their review changes.

username.description: The review changes grouped by username.

ReviewReportRecord.description: Represents a single review change record.

Value.description: The review change value (only for "TextAdd" and "TextRem" types).

ScaleFlag.description: The condition to scale an image in the picture form.

SdtLock.description: The lock type of the content control.

SectionBreakType.description:
The section break type which defines how the contents of the current section are placed relative to the previous section.
WordprocessingML supports five distinct types of section breaks:
**Next page** ("nextPage") - starts a new section on the next page (the default value).
**Odd** ("oddPage") - starts a new section on the next odd-numbered page.
**Even** ("evenPage") - starts a new section on the next even-numbered page.
**Continuous** ("continuous") - starts a new section in the next paragraph.
This means that continuous section breaks might not specify certain page-level section properties,
since they shall be inherited from the following section.
However, these breaks can specify other section properties, such as line numbering and footnote/endnote settings.
**Column** ("nextColumn") - starts a new section in the next column on the page.

SelectionType.description: Represents the type of objects in a selection.

ShadowSettings.description: Properties used to create a shadow.

offsetX.description: The horizontal offset of the shadow measured in points (a positive value offsets to the right).

offsetY.description: The vertical offset of the shadow measured in points (a positive value offsets downwards).

rotateWithShape.description: Specifies whether the shadow rotates together with the shape.

size.description: The shadow size as a percentage of the shape size.

ShapeType.description: This type specifies the preset shape geometry that will be used for a shape.

Type.description: The shading type: **"nil"** - no shading, **"clear"** - solid fill.

ShdType.description: A shade type which can be added to the document element.

SizeRelFromH.description: The possible values for the base which the relative horizontal size of an object will be calculated from.

SizeRelFromV.description: The possible values for the base which the relative vertical size of an object will be calculated from.

StyleType.description: The style type used for the document element.

Pos.description: The tab stop position measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).

bandHor.description: Specifies that the horizontal banding conditional formatting shall not be applied to the table.

bandVer.description: Specifies that the vertical banding conditional formatting shall not be applied to the table.

firstCol.description: Specifies that the first column conditional formatting shall be applied to the table.

firstRow.description: Specifies that the first row conditional formatting shall be applied to the table.

lastCol.description: Specifies that the last column conditional formatting shall be applied to the table.

lastRow.description: Specifies that the last row conditional formatting shall be applied to the table.

TableStyleOverrideType.description:
This simple type specifies possible values for the table sections to which the current conditional formatting properties will be applied when this selected table style is used.
**"topLeftCell"** - specifies that the table formatting is applied to the top left cell.
**"topRightCell"** - specifies that the table formatting is applied to the top right cell.
**"bottomLeftCell"** - specifies that the table formatting is applied to the bottom left cell.
**"bottomRightCell"** - specifies that the table formatting is applied to the bottom right cell.
**"firstRow"** - specifies that the table formatting is applied to the first row.
**"lastRow"** - specifies that the table formatting is applied to the last row.
**"firstColumn"** - specifies that the table formatting is applied to the first column. Any subsequent row which is in *table header* ({@link ApiTableRowPr#SetTableHeader}) will also use this conditional format.
**"lastColumn"** - specifies that the table formatting is applied to the last column.
**"bandedColumn"** - specifies that the table formatting is applied to odd numbered groupings of rows.
**"bandedColumnEven"** - specifies that the table formatting is applied to even numbered groupings of rows.
**"bandedRow"** - specifies that the table formatting is applied to odd numbered groupings of columns.
**"bandedRowEven"** - specifies that the table formatting is applied to even numbered groupings of columns.
**"wholeTable"** - specifies that the conditional formatting is applied to the whole table.

TableWidth.description:
The possible values for the units of the width property are defined by a specific table or table cell width property.
**"auto"** - sets the table or table cell width to auto width.
**"twips"** - sets the table or table cell width to be measured in twentieths of a point.
**"nul"** - sets the table or table cell width to be of a zero value.
**"percent"** - sets the table or table cell width to be measured in percent to the parent container.

TextFitType.description: The available text autofit types inside a shape.

TextFlowDirection.description: The available text flow direction inside a drawing content.

value.description: The format value. Required for **"mask"** and **"regExp"** types.

TickLabelPosition.description:
Possible values for the position of chart tick labels (either horizontal or vertical).
**"none"** - not display the selected tick labels.
**"nextTo"** - set the position of the selected tick labels next to the main label.
**"low"** - set the position of the selected tick labels in the part of the chart with lower values.
**"high"** - set the position of the selected tick labels in the part of the chart with higher values.

TickMark.description: The available types of tick mark appearance.

ToHtmlOptions.description: Options for converting document content to an HTML string.

Base64img.description: Defines if the images will be created in the base64 format.

DemoteHeadings.description: Defines if all heading levels will be demoted to conform with the following standard: single H1 as title, H2 as top-level heading in the text body.

HtmlHeadings.description: Defines if the HTML headings and IDs will be generated when the Markdown renderer of your target platform does not handle Markdown-style IDs.

RenderHTMLTags.description: Defines if HTML tags will be preserved. By default, the opening angle brackets will be replaced with the special characters.

TocBuildFromPr.description: Table of contents properties which specify whether to generate the table of contents from the outline levels or the specified styles.

OutlineLvlStart.description: The highest heading level included in the table of contents (the start of the outline range).

OutlineLvls.description: The lowest heading level included in the table of contents (the end of the outline range).

StylesLvls.description: Style levels (for example, [{Name: "Heading 1", Lvl: 2}, {Name: "Heading 2", Lvl: 3}]).<note>If StylesLvls.length > 0, then the OutlineLvls property will be ignored.</note>

TocLeader.description:
Possible values for the table of contents leader:
**"dot"** - "......."
**"dash"** - "-------"
**"underline"** - "_______"

examples:
let tocPr = {"ShowPageNums": true, "RightAlgn": true, "LeaderType": "dot", "FormatAsLinks": true, "BuildFrom": {"OutlineLvls": 9}, "TocStyle": "standard"};
doc.AddTableOfContents(tocPr);

BuildFrom.description: Specifies whether to generate the table of contents from the outline levels or the specified styles.

FormatAsLinks.description: Specifies whether to format the table of contents as links.

LeaderType.description: The leader type in the table of contents.

RightAlgn.description: Specifies whether to right-align page numbers in the table of contents.

ShowPageNums.description: Specifies whether to show page numbers in the table of contents.

TocStyle.description: The table of contents style type.
Possible values for the table of contents style.

Lvl.description: Level which will be applied to the specified style in the table of contents.

examples:
let tofPr = {"ShowPageNums": true, "RightAlgn": true, "LeaderType": "dot", "FormatAsLinks": true, "BuildFrom": "Figure", "LabelNumber": true, "TofStyle": "distinctive"};
doc.AddTableOfFigures(tofPr);

BuildFrom.description: Specifies whether to generate the table of figures based on the specified caption label or the paragraph style name used (for example, "Heading 1").

FormatAsLinks.description: Specifies whether to format the table of figures as links.

LabelNumber.description: Specifies whether to include the label and number in the table of figures.

LeaderType.description: The leader type in the table of figures.

RightAlgn.description: Specifies whether to right-align page numbers in the table of figures.

ShowPageNums.description: Specifies whether to show page numbers in the table of figures.

TofStyle.description: The table of figures style type.
Possible values for the table of figures style.

TransitionSpeed.description: The available slide transition speed values (similar to PowerPoint VBA ppTransitionSpeed).

VerticalTextAlign.description: The available text vertical alignment (used to align text in a shape with a placement for text inside it).

XmlMapping.description: This element specifies the information which shall be used to establish a mapping to an XML element stored within a Custom XML.

prefixMapping.description: The set of prefix mappings which shall be used to interpret the XPath expression specified in xpath.

pt_8.description: Eighths of a point (24 eighths of a point = 3 points).

twips.description: Twentieths of a point (equivalent to 1/1440th of an inch).
